bundle.shortDescription: Clipboard history with encrypted local storage
bundle.longDescription: CopyPaste keeps a searchable history of everything you copy - text, images and file lists - on your own machine. Clip contents are encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a key sealed to your Windows account.
